# Akash Priyadarshi - Full Context & Technical Documentation

> Systems Developer, Android Internals Specialist, and AI-Augmented Engineer based in Patna, Bihar, India.

## Executive Profile
Akash Priyadarshi (GitHub: AkashPriyadarshii, ID: 272530059) is a self-taught engineer who started coding from scratch in 2025. He operates with a strict Rs 0 budget, employing zero-cost infrastructure, standard-library-first architectures, and AI leverage to build production-grade systems solo. Every public repository in his portfolio is shipped, functional, and actively maintained.

## Core Architectural Principles
1. **Agent-First Tooling**: Building token-budgeted, structured output tools (rustygrep, zcat, repomap) designed to maximize LLM context window efficiency.
2. **Ponytail Anti-Overengineering Ladder**: Never jump to complex solutions. Reuse existing capabilities, prefer standard libraries (Go, Python), and write the minimum code that completely solves the problem.
3. **Immutability & Safety**: Favor pure data transformations, immutable state management, and memory-safe languages (Rust, Zig).
4. **Offline-First & Zero Telemetry**: Prioritize client-side execution, local SQLite storage, and zero-telemetry architectures (e.g., kharcha expense tracker, neet-cbt).

## Detailed Public Portfolio

### 1. rustygrep
- **Language**: Rust
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/rustygrep
- **Description**: High-performance, token-efficient grep utility designed specifically for AI coding agents. Features a built-in Model Context Protocol (stdio MCP) server to provide structured code search directly to LLMs.

### 2. kharcha
- **Language**: Kotlin / Flutter
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/kharcha
- **Description**: India-first UPI expense tracker for Android. Automatically parses SMS and push notifications from Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm. Works 100% offline with zero server dependencies.

### 3. tdlib-android
- **Language**: Kotlin / C++
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/tdlib-android
- **Description**: Precompiled Telegram Database Library (TDLib) binaries built for all 4 Android ABIs (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86) through automated GitHub Actions CI pipelines, published as ready-to-use AAR packages.

### 4. zcat
- **Language**: Zig
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/zcat
- **Description**: A 179KB drop-in replacement for cat that outputs structured JSON tokens formatted for AI agent context ingestion.

### 5. repomap
- **Language**: Go
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/repomap
- **Description**: Generates concise, token-budgeted codebase maps and dependency outlines using strictly the Go standard library.

### 6. My-Starred-Repos
- **Language**: Python
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/My-Starred-Repos
- **Description**: An automated dashboard curating 950+ starred open-source repositories across systems, AI, and Android topics, refreshed daily via GitHub Actions.

### 7. Secondary Tools
- **code2paper** (Python / HTML): Converts full codebases into academic papers (Typst, LaTeX, PDF). URL: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/code2paper
- **sevolve** (Python): Self-evolving agent harness that captures execution traces, grades outputs blindly, and optimizes agent prompt skills without GPUs. URL: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/sevolve
- **ccsync** (JavaScript): Claude Code fleet synchronization tool for MCP configurations and workspace definitions. URL: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/ccsync
- **neet-cbt** (HTML / JS): Full offline PWA simulator replicating the National Testing Agency (NTA) computer-based test environment for NEET aspirants. URL: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/neet-cbt

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Capabilities
Akash's flagship tool `rustygrep` provides an MCP server implementing `grep_search` with token-budget filtering.
- **Manifest Location**: https://akashpriyadarshii.github.io/AkashPriyadarshii/.well-known/mcp.json
- **Transport**: stdio (`rustygrep --mcp`)
